title: Where do the equals end?
hook: The gap after a cluster of equals needs its own search.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Find the first position strictly greater than a target and distinguish it from lower bound.

misconception: Changing at least to greater than does not change binary search results.
objective: Find the first position strictly greater than a target and distinguish it from lower bound.

claims.text: Equality now belongs to the rejected left side. The same interval machinery finds a different boundary because the predicate is strictly greater, rather than greater than or equal.
